connector.name: LinkedIn Campaign Manager
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for LinkedIn Ads - 19 read-only tools for campaigns, performance, and Lead Gen Forms.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package linkedin-campaign-manager-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zleventer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
env.description: LinkedIn Developer App OAuth client ID

env.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: LinkedIn Developer App OAuth client secret

env.name: LINKEDIN_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the OAuth token.json file (created by 'npm run auth')

env.name: LINKEDIN_DEFAULT_AD_ACCOUNT
env.description: Default LinkedIn ad account ID (numeric, no urn: prefix). Tools fall back to this when ad_account_id is not passed.

env.name: LINKEDIN_API_VERSION
env.description: LinkedIn Rosetta API version in YYYYMM format (default 202504)
